confirmed.text: 愿景：面向 AI 重度用户的系统级提示词管理器；全局热键 + 上下文感知 + 模板管理，任何软件中一键调用高质量 Prompt（North_Star.md L4）
KPI：标准输入控件注入成功率 ≥99%；热键到注入 P95 ≤250ms（短文本）/≤1.2s（长文本）；驻留内存 ≤60MB，空闲 CPU≈0；7 天无崩溃（North_Star.md L20-23）
边界：不注入密码框/安全输入控件；不越权高完整性窗口；本地优先（SQLite，加密可选）；任何云同步需显式开启（North_Star.md L25-28）
里程碑：Windows MVP 先行；跨平台为后续扩展方向（North_Star.md L8，本 Phase 扩展为三平台调研）
当前架构：单进程——service 以 lib 形式内嵌为 GUI 线程（src/main.rs:95-98），非独立进程；两根 Named Pipe：promptkey_selector(S→G) 与 promptkey_inject(G→S)
注入现状：仅 Clipboard→SendInput 两级；UIA 于 Phase0(commit cc41dd0 等) 有意删除以降复杂度（CCN 72→9）
Owner 钦定原则：优雅简约；符合真实 UX；新机制可降级；稳定可用优先于功能丰富；UI/UX 全面革新含动效、明暗双主题、中英双版
本 Phase（Phase1）只研究设计，不改 src/service/Cargo.toml 实现代码
Phase2 验收原话：「把五必须和五延后的都给做一下」「UI UX 一定要做好」（task-brief-phase2.md）
图标规则：UI 图标统一用 Lucide 静态 SVG 存 src/icons/（禁手画/字符图标/运行时 CDN）；品牌资产只从 PromptKey.ico 与 PromptKey_aiextract.png 派生，不重新设计
轮盘定稿 A 案：280px 径向、跟随光标、边缘 clamp 16px、中心功能点、打字过滤、数字键直选
市场改造为本地优先模板库：内置精选包 + URL/文件导入 + promptkey-pack v1 导出，无社区后端
拆分 6 个分支各自 PR、全部 --base master、不 auto-merge；每 Task 一 commit 格式 'feat: <what> (LOOM TASK-00X)'
本机无 cargo：Rust 写对不编译验证，交付逐文件列未验证清单；前端用 node --check

assumptions.text: 市场功能在本地优先约束下优先内置精选库+URL 源导入，不做需要后端的社区形态；最终以 MARKET_DECISION.md 为准
提示词+轮盘合并的理解为：轮盘配置内联进提示词列表（pin 为一级操作），轮盘独立导航页取消；最终以 MERGE_ARCHITECTURE.md 为准
UI 延续 Zinc 深色工业风并扩展为明暗双套；不默认引入重型框架，倾向 vanilla+设计 token 化；最终以 UI_UX_REDESIGN.md 为准

unresolved.question: Wayland 下全局热键与注入的硬限制是否被接受为'Linux Wayland 降级为半可用'的产品立场？
unresolved.resolution: 接受。CROSS_PLATFORM_PLAN 已定 Wayland 诚实降级（自动注入依赖 ydotool/uinput/portal 等显式能力），Phase2 仅做 trait 抽象不实装 Linux，由 brief 与 Owner 文档边界授权

unresolved.question: 是否接受 macOS 辅助功能权限带来的首启引导成本？
unresolved.resolution: 接受。macOS 在 Phase3 实装，首启走 Accessibility 权限引导流程，已在 CROSS_PLATFORM_PLAN 承诺

unresolved.question: 内置精选提示词库的内容来源与版权审核由谁负责？
unresolved.resolution: Owner 指派给执行 Agent 策展；按 MARKET_DECISION 采用自撰措辞避免版权风险

gaps.gap: Capability lifecycle state contradicts usage: .loom/capabilities/{design-system,injection-engine,market-model,product-architecture}/status.json all report status 'researching' with empty scenario and confirmed_at, yet tasks.json capability_hooks reference their decision nodes (design-system#C3, design-system#C4, product-architecture#C1, market-model#C2, injection-engine#C1, injection-engine#C5) and PROJECT.md presents them as the project's capability map. The protocol requires unconfirmed dossiers not be referenced by Tasks, or that provisional use be recorded as an assumption; state.json records no such assumption (A-001..003 are all retired Phase-1 items).
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Does not block TASK-001 — the dossier content (full decision trees with sources and counterexamples) is on disk and readable. The gap is authority ambiguity: a fresh agent cannot tell from recorded state whether the trees carry confirmed scenario authority or are provisional drafts, and `loom check` emits four 'researching, not confirmed' warnings as the standing baseline.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Each .loom/capabilities/*/status.json advanced past 'researching' with non-empty scenario and confirmed_at via `loom capability synthesize` + `loom capability confirm --scenario <text> --source human|agent`, OR a recorded assumption/decision stating tasks reference the dossiers provisionally; `loom check` emits no 'researching, not confirmed' warnings.

gaps.gap: tasks.json 'reads' entries fail the project's own validator: TASK-005 reads 'src/js/' which does not exist (it is produced by TASK-001, a listed dependency), TASK-006 reads 'service/src/' which is a directory while reads must name files, and TASK-001 omits 'src/main_simple.js' — the 1365-line file its acceptance criterion splits into ES modules. `loom check` exits non-zero: healthy:false with 2 errors.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Does not block TASK-001 — all ten of its reads exist and first edits are unambiguous (the missing main_simple.js entry is self-evident since the task names it in outcome/touches). The concrete consequence is a failing baseline health check: the delivery loop's first verification command reports errors before any work, so a fresh agent cannot distinguish pre-existing defects from regressions it introduces.
gaps.evidence_to_close: `loom check` reports zero errors (healthy:true): TASK-005 and TASK-006 reads name concrete files (enumerating the actual modules to load rather than directories), and 'src/main_simple.js' is added to TASK-001 reads.

gaps.gap: .loom/STRUCTURE.md is still the uncustomized LOOM template — every section contains generic 'Example:' boilerplate (e.g. 'Example: `src/` for application logic') — while PROJECT.md §Project structure directs agents to it as the source for where files live. The real layout facts exist only inline in PROJECT.md (src/ Tauri shell + vanilla frontend, service/src/ embedded service, src/icons/, .loom/).
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Does not block TASK-001 — PROJECT.md's inline summary plus `ls` suffices to navigate. The consequence is a declared structure file containing zero project truth, flagged by `loom check` ('STRUCTURE.md still contains template instructions'), so an agent reading the pointer finds a placeholder instead of the map.
gaps.evidence_to_close: STRUCTURE.md replaced with this project's actual layout and conventions (src/, service/src/, src/icons/, .loom/, prototypes) such that `loom check` no longer emits the template warning.
